title: Endo vs. Extraction + Implant — Tooth #8 Periapical Pathology

patient.chief_complaint: Anterior tooth pain for 2 weeks, no facial swelling, no fever
patient.medical_history: Prior endodontic treatment on tooth #9 (successful, no issues). No systemic contraindications to endodontic or implant treatment.

clinical_notes: Tooth #8: large periapical radiolucency ~5mm diameter. No vertical root fracture visible on periapical X-ray. No craze lines or frank fracture on clinical exam. Tooth is restorable — adequate coronal structure, margins can be placed in sound tooth structure. Crown not present. Patient reports lingering pain to cold (suggests vital or partially vital pulp vs. failing prior RCT — consider whether this is a primary endo or retreatment case; original endo not documented for #8).
